about.title: About
paragraphs: I am a mechatronics technician working as a *Monteur* (assembly technician) at RATIONAL AG in Landsberg am Lech. In July 2026 I completed my further training as a *staatlich geprüfter Mechatroniktechniker* (state-certified mechatronics technician).

My apprenticeship and the production work that followed gave me hands-on experience in a technical environment. I developed a solid understanding of technical processes and learned to approach problems practically, with an eye for workable solutions.

During my further training I deepened my knowledge of mechanics, electronics and control engineering. I particularly enjoy combining theory with practical application: understanding how things fit together, tracking down faults and finding the right fix are among my strengths.

Away from work I am sporty and spend much of my free time at the gym. Mechatronics and automation interest me privately too — for example in the technical development and control of a small hydroelectric plant in my family.

items.summary: Assembly of a range of modules and components, together with fault finding and repair.
